fact: The health ministry's digital directorate (DISD) reports that the ministry, through a DISD-led team with technicians of the firm WINLOGIC and support from UCPS-Banque Mondiale, deployed the Dossier Patient Informatisé at the Hôpital Général de Ferkessédougou in a mission of 4 to 25 August 2024, and that since 16 August 2024 it is operational there on a local server, with all services including surgery, paediatrics and admissions using it to register and follow patients.
title: Déploiement Réussi du Dossier Patient Informatisé à l'HG de Ferkessédougou : Une Étape Cruciale Vers la Digitalisation des Soins
publisher: Direction de l'Informatique et de la Santé Digitale (DISD)
